response.sql: SELECT acc.account_id, acc.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE NULL END) as avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account acc ON t.account_id = acc.account_id WHERE t.amount >= 2400 GROUP BY acc.account_id, acc.frequency ORDER BY avg_balance DESC LIMIT 10
